verdict.rationale: First-party Cloud API docs explicitly cover pairing multiple Solo readers to a SumUp account, naming them, and triggering payments on them over HTTPS. Virtual Solo lets you test the pairing and checkout flow before switching to a physical reader, and the Reader SDK and Payment Switch cover Bluetooth control and handing payments off to the SumUp app. missing for 10: evidence that setup-to-first-payment takes only minutes, step-by-step pairing/registration instructions, independent or hands-on corroboration of the pairing experience.
